correctness.rationale: For a positive unital real C(K) projection, each μ_t=P*δ_t is a probability measure. Split it as d(t)δ_t+ρ_t with mutually singular nonnegative remainder mass 1−d(t). Then (P−M_f)*δ_t=(d(t)−f(t))δ_t+ρ_t, whose total variation is exactly |d(t)−f(t)|+1−d(t). Supremum over t gives operator norm formula. Muñoz-Lahoz Lemma 2.11 (actual original paper examined) ensures d(t)≥α and at least one t0 with d(t0)=α, α=1/n. Minimizing pointwise gives distance 1−α and full minimizer interval α≤f(t)≤2d(t)−α; constants give the V profile 1−α+|c−α|, and ||I−P||=2(1−α). α=1 implies identity; α=0 excluded. This is a valid direct deduction under exactly the stated hypotheses.
